name: What kind of return on investment can I expect from an interior kitchen or bathroom renovation?
description: Kitchen and bathroom renovations often provide a high return on investment, typically recouping 60-80% or more of the cost, enhancing appeal and functionality.

mainEntity.name: What kind of return on investment can I expect from an interior kitchen or bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen and bathroom renovations typically offer some of the highest returns on investment among interior home improvements. While exact figures vary, you can often recoup a significant portion of your investment, sometimes 60-80% or more, depending on the scope, quality of finishes, and local market conditions. These upgrades enhance both the aesthetic appeal and functionality of your home, attracting potential buyers.
